id.description: ID is the unique NanoID identifier (from filename).

slug.description: Slug is the optional human-readable part of the filename.

path.description: Path is the relative path from .beans/ root (e.g., "epic-auth/abc123-login.md").

order.description: Order is a fractional index string for manual sorting.

body.description: Body is the markdown content after the front matter.

parent.description: Parent is the optional parent item ID (milestone, epic, or feature).

blocking.description: Blocking is a list of item IDs that this item is blocking.

blocked_by.description: BlockedBy is a list of item IDs that are blocking this item.

extra.description: Extra holds front matter keys not covered by any typed field above.

etag.description: Hash of the item file; the value --if-match expects.

Item.title: Item
Item.description: An item as printed by show, create, update, list and the other item verbs.
